title: Batch 6 (M_Master_Toon_Universal) disk landing after storage-crisis recovery

timeline.event: Attempt 1 (editor PID 46348): batch ok in-editor, but its save never flushed; editor process died during the save window and the in-memory mutations were lost.

Attempt 2 (PID 6392): batch ok in-editor; EditorLoadingAndSavingUtils.save_packages returned False. Game thread wedged on building /Game/Custom/BGSlopes/SM_Slope_01 (Required Memory Estimate 12,416 MB) with a MODAL_OPEN; mutations lost again when this instance was replaced.
C: drive at 0.9 GB free. Zen DDC (--data-dir C:/UE_DDC/Zen, --gc-low-diskspace-threshold 2147483648) returns 507 Insufficient Storage; UMaterial saves abort with no disk write and no surfaced error.

FIX: pruned 94,659 cold (>3 days) classic-DDC files (C:/UE_DDC/Buckets 4.15 GB + C:/UE_DDC/Content 11.08 GB = 15.23 GB). Hot entries and the active Zen store untouched. C: free: 0.9 -> 17.2 GB. Saved/Audit evidence NOT touched.
Owner-restarted editor (PID 31492); owner dismissed a boot modal (crash-recovery prompt).
Attempt 3 (PID 31492, Monolith run_python): batch ok; THIS TIME the save reached disk - byte-verified.

disk_verification.byte_check: All six group-name strings '41 | Audio React', '42 | Toon Ramp', '43 | Opacity', '44 | Cloth Wind', '45 | Note Scroll', '46 | Magical Transform' are present in the saved uasset's name table. Old bare group names no longer appear as group labels (remaining substring hits are parameter names like NoteScrollSpeed / MagicalTransform).

durable_trap: C: below Zen's 2 GB low-disk-space guard makes editor saves silently fail: save_asset returns True (or save_packages False) while nothing reaches disk. NEVER trust a save return value - verify by disk timestamp + git hash-object.

Emergency lever proven on this workstation: prune classic-DDC files older than 3 days under C:/UE_DDC/Buckets + C:/UE_DDC/Content (rebuildable on demand, ~15 GB here). Never prune the active Zen store, project Saved/Audit evidence, tracked Content working files, or anything under Perforce.
evidence_level: editor proof (deterministic batch re-run) + byte-level disk verification + git hash delta
